reviews.title: SO FUN BUTTTTT!!!
reviews.text:
This game is so fun and I love the characters and the style and design. No complaints about any of that.
With that being said : 

1. I wish there was more of a community vibe to it. It’s straight to the point and I love that but there’s nothing else. I’m not even sure what “level” I’d be on. Are new clothing’s being unlocked? Is there anything else? I just do the same 12 clothing challenges and there’s nothing for me to be creative. You know? 

2. IT GLITCHES!!!! I wish I read the reviews before paying the .99 $ for it to flash black and white every level? The ads were so insanely annoying to me! And add every single time you clicked on a different category to change an outfit?? That’s outrageous but then have it glitch after you pay to change. It is even worse. Sometimes I can’t even do one level and by sometimes I mean 1 in 2 times I open the app. What is that? Why? 

3. The character are lovely!! It’s honestly not terrible to watch an ad to unlock a special piece of clothing permanently! I don’t know why people are complaining. If you don’t pay you have to watch an ad even if it’s two minutes long you get that item permanently! And it’s worth it in my opinion.

So please, developers fixed the glitching issue because I’m so close to getting my money back.

reviews.title: Cute game but so much glitching and VIP is a subscription?
reviews.text: It's still incredibly irritating to me that it will glitch and force me to quit wherever I'm at. They're replied to my review already telling me they know and are fixing it but it still happens on occasion. Not to mention it tries and forces me to login to my apple account every time multiple times while I'm on the starting screen. Also I accidentally hit the wrong button when trying to leave the VIP screen. I hit the buy button and it said I already bought it (I was aware) but if I want to "manage my subscriptions" I can in my settings. I had no idea it was a subscription and not a one time purchase as I never would have bought it if I had known. It shocked me even further though when it stated that I would be charged $20 for the renewal in September. That's twice the amount it says in the app! You need to label it correctly as a subscription and you need to be more upfront about what it actually costs. I love the game and the outfit options are super cute but this has given me a hugeeeeeeee ick and I'm deleting it after my subscription ends
